# Verify: does the basenji borrow a weapon from the bulldog?
# Closed-world forward chaining over the stated facts and rules.

facts = {
    "basenji": {"money": 90, "name": "Milo", "age": 1.5},
    "swan": {"money": 58},
    "german_shepherd": {"money": 57},
    "seahorse": {"name": "Meadow"},
    # Relations stated in the game state (subject, relation, object)
    "relations": {
        ("bee", "builds_power_plant_near", "songbird_green_fields"),
        ("camel", "trades_piece_with", "husky"),
        ("duck", "enjoys_company_of", "mannikin"),
        ("mannikin", "brings_oil_tank_for", "duck"),
        ("lizard", "negotiates_with", "ostrich"),
        ("owl", "dances_with", "mouse"),
        ("reindeer", "tears_down_castle_of", "pelikan"),
        ("shark", "swears_to", "duck"),
        ("cougar", "not_suspects_truthfulness_of", "camel"),
        ("dachshund", "not_leaves_houses_of", "worm"),
        ("snake", "not_shouts_at", "basenji"),
    },
}

derived = {}  # (animal, predicate) -> True/False

# Rule2: age < 4 -> enjoys company of badger
if facts["basenji"]["age"] < 4:
    derived[("basenji", "enjoys_badger")] = True
print("Rule2 age check:", facts["basenji"]["age"], "< 4 ->", facts["basenji"]["age"] < 4)

# Rule4: money > swan + german shepherd -> enjoys badger
threshold = facts["swan"]["money"] + facts["german_shepherd"]["money"]
r4 = facts["basenji"]["money"] > threshold
print("Rule4 money check:", facts["basenji"]["money"], ">", threshold, "->", r4)
if r4:
    derived[("basenji", "enjoys_badger")] = True

# Rule3: same first letter as seahorse's name -> convinces seal
r3 = facts["basenji"]["name"][0] == facts["seahorse"]["name"][0]
print("Rule3 initials:", facts["basenji"]["name"][0], "==", facts["seahorse"]["name"][0], "->", r3)
if r3:
    derived[("basenji", "convinces_seal")] = True

# Rule5 antecedent: does any animal neglect the swan?
neglects_swan = any(
    obj == "swan" and rel == "neglects"
    for (_, rel, obj) in facts["relations"]
)
print("Rule5 antecedent (someone neglects swan):", neglects_swan)

# Rule5 would forbid borrowing (preferred over Rule7), but its antecedent is false.
rule5_blocks = False
if neglects_swan:
    rule5_blocks = True

# Rule7: convinces seal AND enjoys badger -> borrows bulldog weapon
rule7_fires = (
    derived.get(("basenji", "convinces_seal"), False)
    and derived.get(("basenji", "enjoys_badger"), False)
)
print("Rule7 antecedent (convinces seal and enjoys badger):", rule7_fires)

borrows = rule7_fires and not rule5_blocks
print("Basenji borrows a weapon from the bulldog:", borrows)

submitted = "PROVED"
result = "PROVED" if borrows else "DISPROVED"
if result == "PROVED" and submitted == "PROVED":
    print("CHECK PASS")
elif result == submitted:
    print("CHECK PASS")
else:
    print("CHECK FAIL")
